totalPulled.description: Total messages pulled from the DLQ subscription in this drain.

requeued.description: Messages successfully re-enqueued to the target Cloud Tasks queue.

filtered.description: Messages skipped because they did not match the webhookId/tenantId filter.

failed.description: Messages that failed to re-enqueue; they remain in the DLQ and are retried on the next drain.

results.description: Per-message outcome details for the messages pulled in this drain.

messageId.description: Pub/Sub message id of the DLQ message.

webhookId.description: Webhook id extracted from the failed event, when available.

tenantId.description: Tenant id extracted from the failed event, when available.

status.description: Outcome for this message. One of: REQUEUED (re-enqueued to the target queue), FILTERED (did not match the filter), DRY_RUN (matched but not re-enqueued because dryRun was true), FAILED (could not be re-enqueued or the payload was malformed).

detail.description: Human-readable detail for the outcome, such as the target queue or the failure reason.
